{{Top|leg}}
'''"I Want to Go to Naboo"''' was a song about the first time [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ever saw the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and how he was fascinated with this world. It was created on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by a [[Unidentified young new recruit|young Jedi recruit]].
